subject: [PATCH 3/3] kernfs: free the old name outside kernfs_rwsem

2026-09-13.patch_summary: This patch moves the freeing of an old name in the kernfs_rename_ns function outside of the kernfs_rwsem write lock. The old name is already unpublished by the time it needs to be freed, so there's no need for it to happen under the lock. This change helps prevent potential deadlocks caused by holding the write lock while waiting out a grace period.
